name: Teshigawara Kotoko
source:
The heroine of the second episode.

A senpai at the school where [url=/c112736]Itsuki[/url] attends, she is the daughter of a Yakuza boss, and is proud to be her father's daughter.

She learned of Itsuki and his group's business involving the electronic drug, and gave them permission to do business under her supervision.

[Translated and edited from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1190392&gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
